pins.name: V0
pins.description: contrast voltage: the wiper of a 10 kohm potentiometer between VDD and VSS

pins.name: RW
pins.description: read (1) / write (0); tie to VSS to only write

pins.name: E
pins.description: enable, data latched on its falling edge

parameters.conditions: logic supply current into VDD (display and ST7066U controller, backlight off), VDD=5.0 V; the backlight is fed separately through LED+ (130 mA typ at 5.0 V, 156 mA max)

source.location: p. 5, Electrical Characteristics, Supply Current IDD row

notes: V0 sets the contrast (about 0.5-1.3 V for a 5 V module): a 10 kohm trimmer between VDD and VSS, its wiper to V0.
Not placed by the support circuit, add it where the board needs it: RV1 10kohm between VDD, V0, VSS (contrast: the wiper to V0).
4-bit mode needs six GPIOs: RS, E, DB4-DB7 (RW to VSS). Inputs read high from 0.7 VDD = 3.5 V: a 3.3 V controller is marginal on a 5 V LCD; `LCD1602_I2C` (the PCF8574 backpack) needs two wires.
Backlight: A to 5 V and K to GND; many modules have the series resistor on board (check the module, else 100-220 ohm in series with A).
The standard outline: PCB 80 x 36 mm, Ø2.5 mm holes 75 x 31 mm; pins on 2.54 mm, pin 1 8.00 mm from the left edge.
